cast.A: middle-aged East Asian man, short black hair, white short-sleeve shirt under a red apron, dark gray trousers
cast.B: young East Asian woman, long dark ponytail, light blue hoodie, black jeans

scenes.scene: middle-aged East Asian man, short black hair, white short-sleeve shirt under a red apron, dark gray trousers stands behind a small milk tea counter, pressing five plain colored paper strips—red, yellow, blue, green, white—onto a cup sleeve beside a row of cups.
scenes.note: 店长把五笔不同性质的开支贴到杯套上，叠出一杯奶茶的价格。
scenes.scene_template: {A} stands behind a small milk tea counter, pressing five plain colored paper strips—red, yellow, blue, green, white—onto a cup sleeve beside a row of cups.

scenes.scene: A red paper strip is taped to a single cup; a yellow strip and a blue strip hang from a thick blank wall-mounted block, both stretching down past many cups.
scenes.note: 红贴纸跟着单杯走，黄蓝贴纸挂在整月的固定开支上，要靠卖出很多杯来稀释。
scenes.scene_template: A red paper strip is taped to a single cup; a yellow strip and a blue strip hang from a thick blank wall-mounted block, both stretching down past many cups.

scenes.scene: Left: a tall stack of yellow and blue paper strips rises far above a cup sleeve while middle-aged East Asian man, short black hair, white short-sleeve shirt under a red apron, dark gray trousers peels away half of a white strip. Right: the same five strips lie thin, and a tall white strip covers them.
scenes.note: 左右对比：雨天单少时黄蓝贴纸叠得高过杯套，周五单多时五张贴纸薄薄一层。
scenes.scene_template: Left: a tall stack of yellow and blue paper strips rises far above a cup sleeve while {A} peels away half of a white strip. Right: the same five strips lie thin, and a tall white strip covers them.

scenes.scene: A blank plain colored menu board stays unchanged; beneath it, one cup grows taller, one is mostly ice with a thin foam layer, and one is propped up by a stack of plain colored paper strips.
scenes.note: 灯箱数字没变，杯子里的冰量、奶盖和加料却在变，旁边产品暗中补贴。
scenes.scene_template: A blank plain colored menu board stays unchanged; beneath it, one cup grows taller, one is mostly ice with a thin foam layer, and one is propped up by a stack of plain colored paper strips.

scenes.scene: Four identical cups in a row each wear a different thickness of plain colored paper strips: one huge yellow-and-blue stack, one medium pile, one thin layer, one with extra green strips beside a small plain delivery bag.
scenes.note: 同一款奶茶在机场、商场、社区店和外卖上的成本叠法完全不同。
scenes.scene_template: Four identical cups in a row each wear a different thickness of plain colored paper strips: one huge yellow-and-blue stack, one medium pile, one thin layer, one with extra green strips beside a small plain delivery bag.

scenes.scene: young East Asian woman, long dark ponytail, light blue hoodie, black jeans holds one cup at the counter and counts on her fingers toward middle-aged East Asian man, short black hair, white short-sleeve shirt under a red apron, dark gray trousers; three plain colored paper strips lie on the counter between them.
scenes.note: 顾客端着杯子，用三个手指追问成本、杯数和渠道。
scenes.scene_template: {B} holds one cup at the counter and counts on her fingers toward {A}; three plain colored paper strips lie on the counter between them.
